bio.text: Justin Wagner is the Democratic nominee for Pennsylvania's 16th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 election, having advanced from the May 19, 2026 primary.

According to his campaign website, he was born and raised in Greenville and Transfer, Pennsylvania, graduated from Reynolds High School in 1998, and served in the U.S. Army, including a 2006 deployment to Iraq, followed by service in the Army Reserves.
The campaign site says he has worked for about 15 years as a senior automation engineer, including as an engineer for the City of Seattle.
